intro: Holt Thunderhorn is a tauren hunter trainer stationed upon Hunter Rise in the elevated city of Thunder Bluff. He instructs novice and seasoned track-masters in their craft, offering basic martial guidance and pointing maturing marksmen toward specialized trials across Mulgore and beyond.

p: Perched on Hunter Rise above the sweeping plains of Mulgore, Holt Thunderhorn serves the Horde as a seasoned instructor in ranged combat, tracking, and survival. Like many elders of his craft, he guides young tauren as they make the transition from roaming hunters into disciplined defenders of their new capital.
